name: Slime Volley
hook: Jump, bonk, don't let it touch your sand.
how: Run and jump your slime to bounce the ball over the net. If it lands on your side, the other side scores. First to 7 wins; with 3 or 4 players it's two a side.
controls: A/D or arrows to move, W, ↑ or Space to jump · touch: ◀ ▶ and JUMP buttons
uses: One player's browser moves the ball and keeps the score, so both sides see the same bounce; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
A bot plays the other side until a friend joins, and fills any empty spot in two-a-side.
Every slime and the ball move for everyone at once.
ideas: Make the net higher and the ball lighter
Add a power smash when you jump twice
Make it a snowy mountain with a snowball
